selection_rule: Within each arm, rank every recorded checkpoint by aggregate five-case SSIM descending, PSNR descending, and MSE ascending, then minimize the average of those three ranks. Ties use average ranks and are reported explicitly. Fixed steps 170000 and 180000 tied; step 180000 was retained because it ranked first on two of the three metrics (PSNR and MSE).

runs.label: Concat-fixed
runs.note: Tied step 170000 for the lowest average metric rank; selected because it had the best aggregate PSNR and MSE. Its SSIM was third-best behind steps 170000 and 150000.

runs.label: Concat-random
runs.note: Best recorded aggregate SSIM, PSNR, and MSE.

runs.label: Concat-weighted
runs.note: Best recorded aggregate SSIM, PSNR, and MSE.

caveat: These periodic five-case diagnostics were used for development-only checkpoint selection. They are not final confirmation results and do not estimate performance uncertainty.
